lines.line: Israel versus eight countries. Seven numbers.
One: happiness. Israel beats all eight, eighth in the world.
Two: research. Israel spends the most, almost double anyone here.
Three: life expectancy. Only Japan beats Israel.
Four: babies. Israel tops the chart, above Egypt and Jordan.
Five: median age. Israel, twenty nine. Germany and Japan, over forty five.
Six: soldiers per thousand people. Israel, sixteen. Twice Jordan, four times America.
Israel drafts at eighteen. HAMAS and Hezbollah sit on its borders.
Seven: money per person. Only America is richer. Adjusted for prices, Israel drops to sixth.
Japan lives longer, America earns more. Israel is happiest.
Which number surprised you? Part one, Israel versus the USA, is on my profile.
